# Effects index (generated by `node motion-graphics-library/tests/demo.js index`; do not edit by hand)

All presets: `motion-graphics-library/mgl.js`. Every transition and overlay also takes `intensity` (1 = default) and `ease` where noted in code.
Status comes from the last `demo.js verify` render test.

## Main set: CapCut's 20 popular transitions (user rule 2026-11-07)
Pick transitions from these 20 first, for every clip. Each one's sound comes from the user's `sound effects/sfxv2/` pack (every file <= 1.5 s; the user's files first, `generated/` = synthesized fallbacks, currently unused) and the builder adds it automatically with the hit on the cut (`"sfx": false` on the transition to skip it, `"sfxVol"` to change its volume). It counts toward the skill's SFX cap. The table is `CAPCUT20` in `mgl.js`.

| CapCut name | Preset | Transition SFX |
|---|---|---|
| Pull In | `pull-in` | `sound effects/sfxv2/reverse-ding.mp3` |

## Transitions (`"transitions": [{ "t": <cut s>, "type": ... }]` in shorts.json; one type per scene change)

| Name | Category | What it does | Defaults | Good for | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `zoom-in` | zoom | Push hard into the outgoing shot, incoming lands zoomed and settles | d=0.36 | hype beats, jumping closer to the action | Implemented and tested |
| `zoom-out` | zoom | Outgoing shrinks away, incoming arrives oversized and pulls back to fit | d=0.4 | revealing the bigger picture, scale reveals | Implemented and tested |
| `punch-zoom` | zoom | Incoming hits at +25% and snaps back to full frame (no outgoing motion) | d=0.32 | a strong statement or reaction landing | Implemented and tested |
| `snap-zoom` | zoom | Incoming holds a hard crop for a beat, then snaps to full frame | d=0.22 | comedic beat, sudden focus | Implemented and tested |
| `zoom-blur` | zoom | Zoom-in through a motion blur | d=0.4 | energetic scene jumps, sports | Implemented and tested |
| `push-in` | zoom | Slow dynamic push into the new shot | d=1.2 | building tension, architecture and product shots | Implemented and tested |
| `pull-out` | zoom | New shot starts tight and slowly pulls back | d=1.2 | revealing context, the whole home or space | Implemented and tested |
| `spin` | zoom | Rotate-and-zoom out of the outgoing shot, counter-rotate into the incoming | d=0.42 | playful or chaotic moments | Implemented and tested |
| `whip` | motion | Whip pan: outgoing flies off with motion blur and skew, incoming flies in from the other side (dir) | d=0.32, dir=left | fast scene/location change | Implemented and tested |
| `slide` | motion | Incoming slides in over the frozen last frame of the outgoing shot (dir = travel direction) | d=0.45, dir=left | clean sequential steps, before/after | Implemented and tested |
| `push` | motion | Incoming pushes the frozen outgoing frame off screen (dir = travel direction) | d=0.45, dir=left | list items, next-step changes | Implemented and tested |
| `cross-shake` | motion | CapCut-style cross shake: 4 frames of criss-crossing diagonal whip blur, then lands oversized and settles with jitter | d=0.3 |  | Implemented and tested |
| `shake-cut` | motion | Camera-shake burst on the cut, decaying | d=0.35 | impacts, crashes, drops | Implemented and tested |
| `white-flash` | flash | Bright white flash peaking just after the cut | d=0.3, color=#ffffff | big reveal, photo moment (pair with shutter) | Implemented and tested |
| `black-flash` | flash | Dip to black and back | d=0.32 | time skip, mood change | Implemented and tested |
| `flash-zoom` | flash | White flash with the incoming shot zooming out of it | d=0.34 | hype reveal | Implemented and tested |
| `light-leak` | flash | Warm orange-pink light leak sweeping across the frame | d=0.7 | warm, nostalgic or emotional change | Implemented and tested |
| `exposure` | flash | Over-exposure pulse: the picture blows out to near white and recovers | d=0.36 | dreamy, memory, heat | Implemented and tested |
| `strobe` | flash | Three quick, restrained white strobes around the cut | d=0.36 | party, high energy (use sparingly) | Implemented and tested |
| `flash-impact` | flash | White flash plus a heavy camera shake: for hits and reveals | d=0.4 | payoff hit | Implemented and tested |
| `rgb-split` | glitch | Red/cyan channel split that jitters apart around the cut | d=0.34 | tech, gaming, internet culture | Implemented and tested |
| `glitch` | glitch | Digital glitch: horizontal slices of the picture tear sideways with a skew jitter | d=0.36 | tech or a 'malfunction' moment | Implemented and tested |
| `vhs` | glitch | VHS tape distortion: scanlines, colour bleed and a vertical roll | d=0.5 | retro, throwback footage | Implemented and tested |
| `static` | glitch | TV static interruption over the cut (kit clip static_glitch_0.5s.mp4) | d=0.3 | channel switch, interruption | Implemented and tested |
| `breakup` | glitch | Digital breakup: the frozen outgoing frame shatters into slices that shoot off sideways | d=0.42 | dramatic digital exit | Implemented and tested |
| `blur-to-clear` | blur | Incoming starts heavily blurred and sharpens | d=0.45 | soft scene opening, focus on a new subject | Implemented and tested |
| `focus-pull` | blur | Rack focus: outgoing defocuses, incoming comes into focus with a slight breathe | d=0.5 | emotional or contemplative change | Implemented and tested |
| `radial-blur` | blur | Radial zoom streak: echo layers burst outward from the centre and fade | d=0.4 | speed, acceleration | Implemented and tested |
| `wave-distort` | blur | Liquid wave distortion (SVG displacement) that swells and settles | d=0.5 | dream, confusion, flashback | Implemented and tested |
| `circle-reveal` | creative | Incoming opens as a growing circle from the centre | d=0.5 | spotlight a new subject | Implemented and tested |
| `wipe` | creative | Hard-edged wipe across the frame (dir = wipe direction) | d=0.42, dir=left | comparisons, clean editorial cuts | Implemented and tested |
| `diagonal-wipe` | creative | Angled shape wipe from the corner | d=0.45 | dynamic editorial cut | Implemented and tested |
| `split-reveal` | creative | The frozen outgoing frame splits in two halves that slide apart | d=0.5 | dramatic opening of a new scene | Implemented and tested |
| `pip-in` | creative | Incoming enters as a rounded picture-in-picture card and grows to full frame | d=0.6 | reaction to footage, 'meanwhile' | Implemented and tested |
| `pull-in` | zoom | CapCut 'Pull in': outgoing rushes toward the camera in a bright zoom blur with radial streaks, incoming lands from the rush and settles | d=0.5 | rushing into the next moment, hype | Implemented and tested |
| `pull-back` | zoom | CapCut 'Pull out': outgoing is yanked back away from the camera with blur, incoming starts oversized and blurred and pulls back to fit | d=0.45 | stepping back to show the result | Implemented and tested |
| `whirl` | zoom | CapCut 'Whirl': a big twisting turn (~160 degrees) with zoom and blur out of the outgoing shot, unwinding into the incoming | d=0.5 | chaotic or dizzy turn of events | Implemented and tested |
| `rotate` | motion | CapCut 'Rotate': a crisp 90-degree turn (zoomed to keep the frame filled), no blur; incoming finishes the turn | d=0.45 | playful change of scene, a twist | Implemented and tested |
| `cube` | creative | CapCut 'Cube': the frame turns like the face of a 3D box to show the incoming shot on the next face (dir = left/right) | d=0.55, dir=left | next topic, before/after, list steps | Implemented and tested |
| `swipe` | motion | CapCut 'Swipe': fast feed-style swipe, incoming shoves the outgoing frame off with motion blur on both (dir = travel direction, default up) | d=0.35, dir=up | feed-style 'next', rapid sequence | Implemented and tested |

## Panel graphics (split screen; `"panel": [{ "t", "e", "kind", ... }]` in shorts.json, used by /motivational)
The screen splits (graphic panel top, speaker band below) exactly while a panel graphic is on screen; each graphic generates its own sound (no sound files). Code: `motion-graphics-library/panel.js` (self-check `node motion-graphics-library/panel.js --selftest`). Status: implemented and render-tested (2026-10-28 test clip).

| Kind | What it does | Defaults |
|---|---|---|
| `title` | Headline at the top of the panel, typed in word by word (each word on its time); *accent* words in italic accent colour | y=70, size=66, gap=0.12 |
| `icon` | Neon line icon that draws itself on, glowing, with an optional label (icons: see ICONS) | name=star, color=#39E75F, x=540, y=600, size=330, draw=0.6, label= |
| `list` | Stacked rows that light up one by one on their own times (each row: text, t, color) | y=330, gap=130, items= |
| `quote` | Quote card: big italic quote whose words appear as they're spoken (times = word times), optional author | y=300, size=74, gap=0.18, author= |
| `counter` | Big number counting from `from` to `to` (prefix/suffix) with a label; rising tone across the count | from=0, to=100, prefix=, suffix=, label=, y=470, dur=1.2, color=#39E75F |
| `timeline` | Progress bar with markers that fill to their positions on their times (marks: t, at 0..1, label, color) | y=640, marks= |
| `people` | Ring of person icons filling up around a centre label (n people, fills over `fill` seconds) | n=16, color=#ff3b3b, label=, y=640, r=300, fill=1 |
| `compare` | Two columns (left vs right) whose titles and icons appear on their own times, e.g. before/after, wrong/right | y=420, left=[object Object], right=[object Object] |
| `document` | Script/document card whose sections fill in with coloured lines on their times (sections: t, label, color, lines) | y=260, title=, sections= |
| `screen` | Rounded 'screen' card showing footage from the source (ms = media time, default the same moment) that pops in | y=300, w=640, h=860, ms=null |

Icons: `infinity`, `check`, `cross`, `arrow-up`, `arrow-right`, `mountain`, `trophy`, `clock`, `heart`, `person`, `lightbulb`, `flame`, `target`, `rocket`, `chart-up`, `chart-down`, `money`, `star`, `lock`, `dumbbell`, `calendar`, `stairs`, `eye`, `brain`. Generated sounds: tick (typed word), pop (card/quote), whoosh (slide), shimmer (icon draw), rise (fill/count).

## Already in the builder (`build-shorts.js`, ysc look)
`punch`, `drift` (slow push-in), `shakes`, `flashes`, `arrows` (arrow / circle), `callouts` (chip, plate, label, stamp), headline bar, captions, `sfx`.
Fixed on every clip: opening zoom-out + woosh, hook riser, closing zoom-in + woosh loop.

## HyperFrames registry (installed per project with `hf.sh add <name>`)
38 transition items (e.g. `flash-through-white`, `light-leak`, `glitch`, `cinematic-zoom`, `chromatic-radial-split`, `cross-warp-morph`, `domain-warp-dissolve`, `gravitational-lens`) and 17 caption styles (`caption-kinetic-slam`, `caption-glitch-rgb`, `caption-neon-glow`…). Use them for named looks this library doesn't cover: `bash tools/pipeline/hf.sh catalog --tag=transition`.
